info.title: Swarmy API
info.description: Version 1 control plane. Additive-only within /v1: new routes and fields may appear, nothing is removed or retyped, and deprecations carry an x-sunset date. See docs/api.md.

200.description: Rendered API reference for this server version

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: URL-encoded Subscription JSON; a Last-Event-ID header overrides it

200.description: Server-sent event stream of Event frames

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return images after this name and tag

200.description: The OpenAPI document for this server version

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Wait for a head beyond this sequence

ApiError.description: `provider_text` preserves the original provider error without rewriting it.

AppendMessage.description: Append a user message at the observed log head.

CliAgentChoice.description: Input for CLI agent creation or settings updates.

record.description: Encrypted by the API, never returned by credential endpoints.

CliSession.description: CLI projections retain store record fields for compatibility with existing scripts.

CreateAgent.description: Every client mutation has a key that survives retries of the same intent.

CreateCredential.description: Setting the same provider again replaces its credential without exposing its secret on reads.

CreateImage.description: Register an already built image; image builds are not mutations of this resource.

new.description: Open a side conversation rather than the named agent's main session.

Credential.description: Credential metadata contains no secret material.

CredentialDeleted.description: Deleting a labelled credential reports the removal without returning secrets.

Cursor.description: A sequence is local to one log, starts at one, and increases without gaps.

DeleteRequest.description: Body for agent and credential deletions. The key scopes the replayed result.

DoctorNode.description: One registered node and its committed sandbox memory in bytes.

DoctorSnapshot.description: Protected diagnostic snapshot used by doctor; credential metadata contains no secrets.

nodes.description:
Registered nodes with committed sandbox memory. Older servers omit
this; clients must treat a missing list as unknown, not empty.

Event.description: A durable event has a cursor even when delivered on a multiplexed connection.

oneOf.description: Stored events without a dedicated public projection retain their original data.

data.description: Stored events without a dedicated public projection retain their original data.

GcRun.description:
Durable accounting for one collector attempt. An unfinished record means
the run is still sweeping or its process stopped before persisting final
counters.

HealthResponse.description:
The unauthenticated health projection. `api_version` carries the document
version so clients can accept any server with the same major version.

default_provider.description: The provider new conversations use when the request names none.

ImageUpload.description: A published image with its chunk statistics.

oneOf.description:
Ephemeral turn timeline observations. Live-only: cursors are ignored
and events are numbered per connection, so reconnects replay nothing.

id.description:
Ephemeral turn timeline observations. Live-only: cursors are ignored
and events are numbered per connection, so reconnects replay nothing.

LogId.description: A log namespace. The tagged representation reserves channels without changing session cursors.

ProbeModel.description:
Probe a model with a live request through the control plane's stored
credentials. The optional label selects one labelled credential entry.

ProbeResult.description:
The control plane's probe answer mirrors the CLI probe summary: catalog
usage and cost for one short completion plus the effort actually used.

StartGcRun.description: Start a chunk collection run on the control plane.

grace_seconds.description:
Override the service's grace window for this run only, in seconds.
Benchmarks on isolated namespaces use a short grace; production runs
omit it and keep the configured window.

Subscription.description: One connection may replay and follow several logs at once.

UpdateSession.description: `close` terminates the session; other fields override inference selection.

WaitingReason.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp is used for `wake_at`; reasons are human-readable.
